requirement.statement: WorkFlow and BizProcess SHALL persist each selected If branch before entering its body and SHALL reuse that decision after suspension or restart without re-evaluating completed predicates.

case.given: a flow selected a branch then suspended
case.then: the selected branch SHALL be reused and predicate code SHALL not run again

requirement.statement: BizProcess TaskStep SHALL output task outcome data for approved, refused, forwarded and abandoned states; business outcomes MUST NOT be converted to technical success/failure routing.

case.then: the next If SHALL receive outcome refused and the flow SHALL remain technically healthy
the next If SHALL receive outcome forwarded as data
